    rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar : REAL := 3.25;     (* Nominal static pneumatic balancing pressure [bar] *)
    rDancerServoTrimVelocity_mpmin  : REAL := 0.0;      (* Decoupled velocity compensation for unwind servo [m/min] *)

    (* Laser Slitter Process Adaptation Parameters *)
    rFilteredBurrInternal_um        : REAL := 0.85;     (* Internal recursive average burr height [um] *)
    rLaserPulseOverlap_ratio        : REAL := 0.82;     (* Calculated pulse overlap ratio *)
    rLaserAdaptivePowerOffset_W     : REAL := 0.0;      (* Dynamic burr feedback laser power trim [W] *)
    rLaserGasPressureTrim_bar       : REAL := 0.0;      (* Dynamic assist gas trim [bar] *)

    (* ISA-88 State Machine & Supervisory Process Timers *)
    iMachineState                   : INT  := 0;        (* Current execution phase *)
    iTargetState                    : INT  := 0;        (* Target sequence state index *)
    tPhaseTimer                     : TON;              (* Multi-purpose state dwell & stabilization timer *)
    tSpliceWatchdogTimer            : TON;              (* High-speed turret flying splice safety watchdog *)
    tEmergencyBrakeTimer            : TON;              (* Deceleration slip prevention timer *)

    (* Iterators & Scratch Variables *)
    idx_i                           : INT;
    idx_j                           : INT;

    rTempCalc                       : REAL;

    (* Constant Physical & Geometric Parameters *)
    c_rSamplingPeriod_s             : REAL := 0.002;    (* Discrete scan cycle period Ts = 2.0 ms [s] *)
    c_rCoreRadius_m                 : REAL := 0.0381;   (* 3.0-inch core radius (76.2 mm diameter / 2) [m] *)
    c_rCoreInertia_kgm2             : REAL := 0.420;    (* Shaft and mandrel mechanical polar inertia [kg*m^2] *)
    c_rGearRatioUnwind              : REAL := 3.250;    (* Unwind servo planetary gearbox reduction ratio *)
    c_rGearRatioRewind              : REAL := 2.850;    (* Rewind servo planetary gearbox reduction ratio *)
    c_rDancerArmMass_kg             : REAL := 2.850;    (* Lumped mass of dancer carriage & roll [kg] *)
    c_rDancerPistonArea_m2          : REAL := 0.001963; (* Dancer pneumatic cylinder effective area (50mm bore) [m^2] *)
    c_rMaxAllowableTension_N        : REAL := 32.0;     (* Absolute upper tension limit before foil necking [N] *)
    c_rMinAllowableTension_N        : REAL := 1.20;     (* Absolute lower tension limit to prevent web slackening [N] *)
    c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N         : REAL := 0.85;     (* Maximum permissible load cell inter-channel drift [N] *)
    c_rCriticalBurrThreshold_um     : REAL := 1.80;     (* Laser slitting edge burr trip threshold [um] *)
    c_rWarningBurrThreshold_um      : REAL := 1.35;     (* Laser slitting edge burr warning threshold [um] *)
    c_rMaxLaserCollimatorTemp_degC  : REAL := 48.0;     (* Laser optical cutting head overtemperature trip [deg C] *)
    c_rMinAssistGasPressure_bar     : REAL := 4.50;     (* Assist gas minimum pressure interlock limit [bar] *)
    c_rMinChillerFlow_Lmin          : REAL := 12.0;     (* Minimum allowable laser deionized cooling flow [L/min] *)

(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 1: SIL-3 / IEC 61508 CAT 4 PLe HARDWARE SAFETY INTERLOCKS & IMMEDIATE TRIP HIERARCHY
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* Immediate Deterministic De-Energization upon E-Stop Chain Rupture *)
IF NOT bSafetyRelayChainOk THEN
    (* Clamp all servo torque commands to emergency regenerative deceleration limit *)
    rCmdUnwindTorque_Nm         := 0.0;
    rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin  := 0.0;
    rCmdRewindTorque_Nm         := 0.0;
    rCmdDancerPressure_bar      := 0.0;
    rCmdDancerVoiceCoil_N       := 0.0;
    rCmdEdgeGuideCorrection_mm  := 0.0;

    (* Instantaneously shut off high-power laser beam and close safety shutter *)
    bLaserEmissionPermissive    := FALSE;
    rCmdLaserPower_W            := 0.0;
    rCmdLaserPulseFreq_kHz      := 0.0;
    rCmdLaserDutyCycle_pct      := 0.0;
    rCmdLaserGasFlow_bar        := 0.0;
    rCmdLaserFocusOffset_um     := 0.0;

    (* Assert Trip Diagnostic Bitmasks *)
    wAlarmCodeWord1.0           := TRUE;    (* Bit 0: Hardware E-Stop Tripped *)
    bSystemAlarmSummary         := TRUE;
    wSystemStatusWord           := 16#E000; (* Emergency fault active *)
    bDegradedModeActive         := FALSE;
    iMachineState               := 999;     (* Immediate jump to failsafe state *)
    iActiveMachineState         := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Critical Laser Head Thermal Runaway Interlock *)
IF (rLaserCollimatorTemp_degC > c_rMaxLaserCollimatorTemp_degC) THEN
    bLaserEmissionPermissive    := FALSE;
    rCmdLaserPower_W            := 0.0;
    wAlarmCodeWord2.0           := TRUE;    (* Laser Collimator Overtemperature Trip *)
    bSystemAlarmSummary         := TRUE;
    IF (iMachineState = 40) OR (iMachineState = 30) THEN
        iMachineState           := 70;      (* Initiate controlled deceleration stop *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Laser Assist Gas Starvation Interlock (prevents foil burning and optical window contamination) *)
IF (rLaserAssistGasPress_bar < c_rMinAssistGasPressure_bar) AND (bLaserEmissionPermissive) THEN
    bLaserEmissionPermissive    := FALSE;
    rCmdLaserPower_W            := 0.0;
    wAlarmCodeWord2.1           := TRUE;    (* Assist Gas Pressure Low Trip *)
    bSystemAlarmSummary         := TRUE;
    IF (iMachineState = 40) THEN
        iMachineState           := 70;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Chiller Coolant Loss Interlock *)
IF (rLaserChillerFlow_Lmin < c_rMinChillerFlow_Lmin) AND (bLaserEmissionPermissive) THEN
    bLaserEmissionPermissive    := FALSE;
    rCmdLaserPower_W            := 0.0;
    wAlarmCodeWord2.2           := TRUE;    (* Laser Chiller Flow Loss *)
    bSystemAlarmSummary         := TRUE;
    IF (iMachineState = 40) THEN
        iMachineState           := 70;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) PRE-SLITTER WEB TENSION VOTING CORE
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* Plausibility & Physical Boundary Validation (0.0 N to 60.0 N dynamic range) *)
bTMR_ChanA_Valid := (rLoadCellTMR_A_N >= 0.0) AND (rLoadCellTMR_A_N <= 60.0);
bTMR_ChanB_Valid := (rLoadCellTMR_B_N >= 0.0) AND (rLoadCellTMR_B_N <= 60.0);
bTMR_ChanC_Valid := (rLoadCellTMR_C_N >= 0.0) AND (rLoadCellTMR_C_N <= 60.0);

(* Evaluate Pairwise Absolute Deviations *)
rDiff_AB := ABS(rLoadCellTMR_A_N - rLoadCellTMR_B_N);
rDiff_BC := ABS(rLoadCellTMR_B_N - rLoadCellTMR_C_N);
rDiff_CA := ABS(rLoadCellTMR_C_N - rLoadCellTMR_A_N);

(* 2oo3 Voting Decision Engine *)
IF bTMR_ChanA_Valid AND bTMR_ChanB_Valid AND bTMR_ChanC_Valid THEN
    IF (rDiff_AB <= c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) AND (rDiff_BC <= c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) AND (rDiff_CA <= c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) THEN
        (* Case 2.1: Full Three-Channel Consensus - Compute Median without dynamic memory *)
        rVotedWebTension_N  := rLoadCellTMR_A_N + rLoadCellTMR_B_N + rLoadCellTMR_C_N
                               - MIN(rLoadCellTMR_A_N, MIN(rLoadCellTMR_B_N, rLoadCellTMR_C_N))
                               - MAX(rLoadCellTMR_A_N, MAX(rLoadCellTMR_B_N, rLoadCellTMR_C_N));
        iHealthySensorCount := 3;
        bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;
        wAlarmCodeWord1.4   := FALSE;   (* Clear TMR drift alarm *)

    ELSIF (rDiff_BC <= c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) AND (rDiff_AB > c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) THEN
        (* Case 2.2: Channel A Drift - Quarantine Channel A, Degrade to 1oo2 of (B, C) *)
        rVotedWebTension_N  := (rLoadCellTMR_B_N + rLoadCellTMR_C_N) * 0.5;
        iHealthySensorCount := 2;
        bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
        wAlarmCodeWord1.4   := TRUE;    (* TMR Sensor Drift: Channel A quarantined *)

    ELSIF (rDiff_CA <= c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) AND (rDiff_AB > c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) THEN
        (* Case 2.3: Channel B Drift - Quarantine Channel B, Degrade to 1oo2 of (A, C) *)
        rVotedWebTension_N  := (rLoadCellTMR_A_N + rLoadCellTMR_C_N) * 0.5;
        iHealthySensorCount := 2;
        bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
        wAlarmCodeWord1.4   := TRUE;    (* TMR Sensor Drift: Channel B quarantined *)

    ELSIF (rDiff_AB <= c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) AND (rDiff_BC > c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) THEN
        (* Case 2.4: Channel C Drift - Quarantine Channel C, Degrade to 1oo2 of (A, B) *)
        rVotedWebTension_N  := (rLoadCellTMR_A_N + rLoadCellTMR_B_N) * 0.5;
        iHealthySensorCount := 2;
        bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
        wAlarmCodeWord1.4   := TRUE;    (* TMR Sensor Drift: Channel C quarantined *)

    ELSE
        (* Case 2.5: Multi-Channel Divergence - Total Loss of Consensus *)
        rVotedWebTension_N  := (rLoadCellTMR_A_N + rLoadCellTMR_B_N + rLoadCellTMR_C_N) / 3.0;
        iHealthySensorCount := 0;
        wAlarmCodeWord1.5   := TRUE;    (* Critical: Total TMR Consensus Lost *)
        bSystemAlarmSummary := TRUE;
        iMachineState       := 999;     (* Trip immediately to failsafe abort *)
    END_IF;

ELSIF bTMR_ChanB_Valid AND bTMR_ChanC_Valid THEN
    rVotedWebTension_N      := (rLoadCellTMR_B_N + rLoadCellTMR_C_N) * 0.5;
    iHealthySensorCount     := 2;
    bDegradedModeActive     := TRUE;
    wAlarmCodeWord1.4       := TRUE;

ELSIF bTMR_ChanA_Valid AND bTMR_ChanC_Valid THEN
    rVotedWebTension_N      := (rLoadCellTMR_A_N + rLoadCellTMR_C_N) * 0.5;
    iHealthySensorCount     := 2;
    bDegradedModeActive     := TRUE;
    wAlarmCodeWord1.4       := TRUE;

ELSIF bTMR_ChanA_Valid AND bTMR_ChanB_Valid THEN
    rVotedWebTension_N      := (rLoadCellTMR_A_N + rLoadCellTMR_B_N) * 0.5;
    iHealthySensorCount     := 2;
    bDegradedModeActive     := TRUE;
    wAlarmCodeWord1.4       := TRUE;

ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Bank Loss *)
    rVotedWebTension_N      := rWebTensionSetpoint_N;
    iHealthySensorCount     := 0;
    wAlarmCodeWord1.5       := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarmSummary     := TRUE;
    iMachineState           := 999;
END_IF;

(* Instantaneous Web Break & Web Rupture Detection *)
IF (iMachineState >= 30) AND (iMachineState <= 60) THEN
    IF (rVotedWebTension_N < c_rMinAllowableTension_N) AND (rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin > 30.0) THEN
        wAlarmCodeWord1.1   := TRUE;    (* Foil Web Break Detected *)
        bSystemAlarmSummary := TRUE;
        iMachineState       := 999;
    ELSIF (rVotedWebTension_N > c_rMaxAllowableTension_N) THEN
        wAlarmCodeWord1.2   := TRUE;    (* Foil Over-Tension Plastic Necking Trip *)
        bSystemAlarmSummary := TRUE;
        iMachineState       := 999;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 3: FOIL CONTINUUM RHEOLOGY & REAL-TIME SPOOL POLAR INERTIA ESTIMATION
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* Foil Material Physical Configuration *)
IF iFoilMaterialSelect = 0 THEN
    (* Cold-Rolled Ultra-Thin Anode Copper Foil (Cu) *)
    rFoilDensity_kg_m3      := 8960.0;  (* kg/m^3 *)
ELSE
    (* High-Purity Cathode Aluminum Foil (Al) *)
    rFoilDensity_kg_m3      := 2700.0;  (* kg/m^3 *)
END_IF;

(* Cross-Sectional Geometry & Longitudinal Stiffness *)
rCalculatedArea_m2          := (rFoilWidth_mm * 1.0E-3) * (rFoilThickness_um * 1.0E-6);
IF rCalculatedArea_m2 > 1.0E-9 THEN
    rEffectiveStiffness_EA_N    := (rFoilYoungsModulus_GPa * 1.0E9) * rCalculatedArea_m2;
    rFoilStress_MPa             := (rVotedWebTension_N / rCalculatedArea_m2) * 1.0E-6;
    rCalculatedWebStrain_pct    := (rVotedWebTension_N / rEffectiveStiffness_EA_N) * 100.0;
    IF rFoilYieldStrength_MPa > 10.0 THEN
        rYieldSafetyMargin_pct  := (1.0 - (rFoilStress_MPa / rFoilYieldStrength_MPa)) * 100.0;
    ELSE
        rYieldSafetyMargin_pct  := 50.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCalculatedArea_m2          := 2.925E-6;
    rEffectiveStiffness_EA_N    := 321750.0;
    rFoilStress_MPa             := 0.0;
    rCalculatedWebStrain_pct    := 0.0;
    rYieldSafetyMargin_pct      := 100.0;
END_IF;

(* Online Spool Radius Tracking with First-Order Digital Filtering *)
IF (rUnwindRollDiameter_mm >= 76.2) AND (rUnwindRollDiameter_mm <= 1200.0) THEN
    rFilteredUnwindRadius_m := (0.005 * (rUnwindRollDiameter_mm * 0.5 * 1.0E-3)) + (0.995 * rFilteredUnwindRadius_m);
ELSE
    rFilteredUnwindRadius_m := c_rCoreRadius_m;
END_IF;

IF (rRewindRollDiameter_mm >= 76.2) AND (rRewindRollDiameter_mm <= 1200.0) THEN
    rFilteredRewindRadius_m := (0.005 * (rRewindRollDiameter_mm * 0.5 * 1.0E-3)) + (0.995 * rFilteredRewindRadius_m);
ELSE
    rFilteredRewindRadius_m := c_rCoreRadius_m;
END_IF;

(* Continuous Spool Polar Inertia J(R) Computation *)
rTempCalc := (3.14159265 * 0.5 * rFoilDensity_kg_m3 * (rFoilWidth_mm * 1.0E-3));
rEstimatedUnwindInertia_kgm2 := c_rCoreInertia_kgm2 + (rTempCalc * (EXPT(rFilteredUnwindRadius_m, 4) - EXPT(c_rCoreRadius_m, 4)));
rEstimatedRewindInertia_kgm2 := c_rCoreInertia_kgm2 + (rTempCalc * (EXPT(rFilteredRewindRadius_m, 4) - EXPT(c_rCoreRadius_m, 4)));

(* Numerical Differentiation of Line Acceleration *)
rWebAcceleration_mps2 := ((rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin - rPrevLineSpeed_mpmin) / (60.0 * c_rSamplingPeriod_s));
rPrevLineSpeed_mpmin  := rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin;

(* Feedforward Inertia & Dynamic Back-Tension Torque Synthesis *)
IF rFilteredUnwindRadius_m > 0.030 THEN
    rInertiaFeedforwardTorque_Nm := (rEstimatedUnwindInertia_kgm2 * (rWebAcceleration_mps2 / rFilteredUnwindRadius_m)) / c_rGearRatioUnwind;
    rTensionTensionTorque_Nm     := (rWebTensionSetpoint_N * rFilteredUnwindRadius_m) / c_rGearRatioUnwind;
ELSE
    rInertiaFeedforwardTorque_Nm := 0.0;
    rTensionTensionTorque_Nm     := 0.0;
END_IF;
(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 4: DECOUPLED DANCER SERVO POSITION REGULATION & PNEUMATIC BIAS CONTROL
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* Raw Dancer Displacement Filtering: Low-pass filter to reject structural machine vibration *)
rDancerPos_Raw_mm  := rDancerPosition_mm;
rDancerPos_Filt_mm := (0.15 * rDancerPos_Raw_mm) + (0.85 * rDancerPos_Filt_mm);

(* Dancer Velocity Estimation: dx_d/dt *)
rDancerVel_Calc_m_s := ((rDancerPos_Filt_mm - rDancerPos_Prev_mm) * 1.0E-3) / c_rSamplingPeriod_s;
rDancerPos_Prev_mm  := rDancerPos_Filt_mm;
rDancerVel_Filt_m_s := (0.20 * rDancerVel_Calc_m_s) + (0.80 * rDancerVel_Filt_m_s);

(* Decoupled Web Velocity Feedforward Trim *)
(* When dancer moves downward (+dx_d/dt), web is stored; unwind speed must surge to compensate *)
rDancerServoTrimVelocity_mpmin := (2.0 * rDancerVel_Filt_m_s * 60.0) + (1.25 * rDancerPos_Filt_mm);

(* Dancer Pneumatic Cylinder Force Balancing:
   F_cyl = 2 * T_ref * cos(theta) + m_d * d^2(x_d)/dt^2 + b_d * dx_d/dt *)
IF c_rDancerPistonArea_m2 > 1.0E-6 THEN
    rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar := ((2.0 * rWebTensionSetpoint_N) + (c_rDancerArmMass_kg * 9.81)) / (c_rDancerPistonArea_m2 * 1.0E5);
    IF rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar > 6.0 THEN
        rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar := 6.0;
    ELSIF rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar < 0.5 THEN
        rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar := 0.5;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Voice-Coil High-Frequency Micro-Trim (suppresses micro-flutter < 50 Hz) *)
rCmdDancerVoiceCoil_N := -(18.5 * rDancerVel_Filt_m_s) - (0.85 * (rVotedWebTension_N - rWebTensionSetpoint_N));
IF rCmdDancerVoiceCoil_N > 25.0 THEN
    rCmdDancerVoiceCoil_N := 25.0;
ELSIF rCmdDancerVoiceCoil_N < -25.0 THEN
    rCmdDancerVoiceCoil_N := -25.0;
END_IF;

(* Dancer Stroke Travel Boundary Limits *)
IF (ABS(rDancerPos_Filt_mm) > 42.0) THEN
    wAlarmCodeWord1.3   := TRUE;    (* Dancer Travel Excursion Warning *)
    IF (ABS(rDancerPos_Filt_mm) > 48.0) AND (iMachineState = 40) THEN
        wAlarmCodeWord1.0   := TRUE;(* Hard Endstop Reached: Initiate Stop *)
        iMachineState       := 70;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    wAlarmCodeWord1.3   := FALSE;
END_IF;
(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 5: DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MPC QUADRATIC COST OPTIMIZATION KERNEL
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* Construct Measurement Error State Vector *)
aState_x[1] := rVotedWebTension_N - rWebTensionSetpoint_N;             (* x1: Pre-slitter tension error [N] *)
aState_x[2] := rDancerPos_Filt_mm * 1.0E-3;                            (* x2: Dancer displacement [m] *)
aState_x[3] := rDancerVel_Filt_m_s;                                    (* x3: Dancer velocity [m/s] *)
aState_x[4] := rPostSlitZoneTension_N - rWebTensionSetpoint_N;         (* x4: Post-slitter tension error [N] *)
aState_x[5] := (rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin - rLineSpeedSetpoint_mpmin) / 60.0; (* x5: Capstan speed error [m/s] *)
aState_x[6] := (rLaserSlitterBurr_um - 0.85);                          (* x6: Laser edge burr deviation [um] *)

(* Update Reference Vector *)
aMPC_Setpoint_r[1] := 0.0;  (* Tension error target = 0 N *)
aMPC_Setpoint_r[2] := 0.0;  (* Dancer centered = 0 mm *)
aMPC_Setpoint_r[3] := 0.0;  (* Post-slit error target = 0 N *)
aMPC_Setpoint_r[4] := 0.0;  (* Burr deviation target = 0 um *)

(* State-Space Observer: Propagate x_next = A_d * x + B_d * u *)
FOR idx_i := 1 TO 6 DO
    rMatAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR idx_j := 1 TO 6 DO
        rMatAccumulator := rMatAccumulator + (aA_mat[idx_i, idx_j] * aState_x[idx_j]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR idx_j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rMatAccumulator := rMatAccumulator + (aB_mat[idx_i, idx_j] * aControl_u[idx_j]);
    END_FOR;
    aState_x_next[idx_i] := rMatAccumulator;
END_FOR;

(* Output Reconstruction: y = C_d * x *)
FOR idx_i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rMatAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR idx_j := 1 TO 6 DO
        rMatAccumulator := rMatAccumulator + (aC_mat[idx_i, idx_j] * aState_x[idx_j]);
    END_FOR;
    aOutput_y[idx_i] := rMatAccumulator;
END_FOR;

(* Compute Instantaneous Quadratic Tracking Cost J = e^T * Q * e + delta_u^T * R * delta_u *)
rMPC_CostValue := 0.0;
FOR idx_i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempCalc := aOutput_y[idx_i] - aMPC_Setpoint_r[idx_i];
    rMPC_CostValue := rMPC_CostValue + (aMPC_Q_diag[idx_i] * rTempCalc * rTempCalc);
    rTempCalc := aControl_u[idx_i] - aControl_u_prev[idx_i];
    rMPC_CostValue := rMPC_CostValue + (aMPC_R_diag[idx_i] * rTempCalc * rTempCalc);
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Descent Solver (8 Iterations in Deterministic Real-Time) *)
FOR iMPC_Iter := 1 TO 8 DO
    (* Gradient Evaluation: g = Q * (y - r) + R * (u - u_prev) *)
    FOR idx_i := 1 TO 4 DO
        aMPC_Grad_g[idx_i] := (aMPC_Q_diag[idx_i] * (aOutput_y[idx_i] - aMPC_Setpoint_r[idx_i]))
                             + (aMPC_R_diag[idx_i] * (aControl_u[idx_i] - aControl_u_prev[idx_i]));
    END_FOR;

    (* Projected Actuator Gradient Descent Step *)
    aControl_u[1] := aControl_u[1] - (rMPC_StepSize_alpha * aMPC_Grad_g[1]);
    aControl_u[2] := aControl_u[2] - (rMPC_StepSize_alpha * aMPC_Grad_g[2]);
    aControl_u[3] := aControl_u[3] - (rMPC_StepSize_alpha * aMPC_Grad_g[3]);
    aControl_u[4] := aControl_u[4] - (rMPC_StepSize_alpha * aMPC_Grad_g[4]);

    (* Hard Box Constraint Saturation *)
    (* u1: Unwind Torque Trim [-45.0 .. +45.0 Nm] *)
    IF aControl_u[1] > 45.0 THEN aControl_u[1] := 45.0;
    ELSIF aControl_u[1] < -45.0 THEN aControl_u[1] := -45.0; END_IF;

    (* u2: Capstan Speed Delta [-50.0 .. +50.0 m/min] *)
    IF aControl_u[2] > 50.0 THEN aControl_u[2] := 50.0;
    ELSIF aControl_u[2] < -50.0 THEN aControl_u[2] := -50.0; END_IF;

    (* u3: Dancer Pneumatic Pressure Trim [-1.5 .. +1.5 bar] *)
    IF aControl_u[3] > 1.5 THEN aControl_u[3] := 1.5;
    ELSIF aControl_u[3] < -1.5 THEN aControl_u[3] := -1.5; END_IF;

    (* u4: Laser Power Trim [-120.0 .. +120.0 W] *)
    IF aControl_u[4] > 120.0 THEN aControl_u[4] := 120.0;
    ELSIF aControl_u[4] < -120.0 THEN aControl_u[4] := -120.0; END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Store Previous Control Vector for Slew Penalty *)
FOR idx_i := 1 TO 4 DO
    aControl_u_prev[idx_i] := aControl_u[idx_i];
END_FOR;
(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 6: CLOSED-LOOP LASER SLITTING SPECTROSCOPY & ADAPTIVE BURR SUPPRESSION
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* Dual-Pole Digital Low-Pass Filter on Optical Burr Feedback *)
rFilteredBurrInternal_um := (0.08 * rLaserSlitterBurr_um) + (0.92 * rFilteredBurrInternal_um);
rFilteredBurr_um         := rFilteredBurrInternal_um;

(* Verify Burr Tolerance Envelopes *)
bBurrWithinSpec := (rFilteredBurr_um <= c_rWarningBurrThreshold_um);

(* Adaptive Laser Power Synthesis: Baseline proportional to line speed + MPC trim + burr feedback *)
IF (rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin > 10.0) THEN
    (* Kerf energy model: P_base = k_material * v_line *)
    IF iFoilMaterialSelect = 0 THEN
        (* Copper Foil (higher optical reflectivity at 1070nm, requires higher cutting energy) *)
        rCmdLaserPower_W := (0.420 * rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin) + 65.0 + aControl_u[4];
        rCmdLaserPulseFreq_kHz := 450.0 + (0.25 * rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin);
        rCmdLaserDutyCycle_pct := 65.0;
    ELSE
        (* Aluminum Foil (lower melt temperature, higher kerf expulsion ease) *)
        rCmdLaserPower_W := (0.280 * rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin) + 40.0 + aControl_u[4];
        rCmdLaserPulseFreq_kHz := 350.0 + (0.20 * rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin);
        rCmdLaserDutyCycle_pct := 55.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Laser Pulse Overlap Calculation: O_p = 1 - (v / (f * d_spot)) *)
    IF (rCmdLaserPulseFreq_kHz > 10.0) THEN
        rLaserPulseOverlap_ratio := 1.0 - ((rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin / 60.0) / ((rCmdLaserPulseFreq_kHz * 1.0E3) * 18.0E-6));
    ELSE
        rLaserPulseOverlap_ratio := 0.85;
    END_IF;

    (* Active Burr Closed-Loop Correction *)
    IF rFilteredBurr_um > c_rWarningBurrThreshold_um THEN
        (* Burr rising: Increase pulse overlap by boosting repetition frequency and gas purge *)
        rLaserAdaptivePowerOffset_W := (rFilteredBurr_um - c_rWarningBurrThreshold_um) * 35.0;
        rLaserGasPressureTrim_bar   := (rFilteredBurr_um - c_rWarningBurrThreshold_um) * 2.5;
        rLaserFocusZ_Trim_um        := -(rFilteredBurr_um - c_rWarningBurrThreshold_um) * 4.0;
        wAlarmCodeWord2.3           := TRUE;    (* Edge Burr Warning Bit *)

        (* Check Critical Persistent Burr Excursion *)
        tBurrAlarmIntegrator(IN := (rFilteredBurr_um > c_rCriticalBurrThreshold_um), PT := T#1500MS);
        IF tBurrAlarmIntegrator.Q THEN
            wAlarmCodeWord2.4   := TRUE;        (* Burr Scrap Alarm: Force Graceful Speed Throttling *)
            bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rLaserAdaptivePowerOffset_W := 0.0;
        rLaserGasPressureTrim_bar   := 0.0;
        rLaserFocusZ_Trim_um        := 0.0;
        wAlarmCodeWord2.3           := FALSE;
        wAlarmCodeWord2.4           := FALSE;
        tBurrAlarmIntegrator(IN := FALSE);
    END_IF;

    (* Apply Dynamic Trims *)
    rCmdLaserPower_W       := rCmdLaserPower_W + rLaserAdaptivePowerOffset_W;
    rCmdLaserGasFlow_bar   := 6.5 + rLaserGasPressureTrim_bar;
    rCmdLaserFocusOffset_um:= rLaserFocusZ_Trim_um;

    (* Clamp Laser Actuation Envelopes *)
    IF rCmdLaserPower_W > 950.0 THEN rCmdLaserPower_W := 950.0;
    ELSIF rCmdLaserPower_W < 0.0 THEN rCmdLaserPower_W := 0.0; END_IF;

    IF rCmdLaserGasFlow_bar > 12.0 THEN rCmdLaserGasFlow_bar := 12.0;
    ELSIF rCmdLaserGasFlow_bar < 4.0 THEN rCmdLaserGasFlow_bar := 4.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rCmdLaserPower_W       := 0.0;
    rCmdLaserPulseFreq_kHz := 0.0;
    rCmdLaserDutyCycle_pct := 0.0;
    rCmdLaserGasFlow_bar   := 0.0;
    rCmdLaserFocusOffset_um:= 0.0;
END_IF;
(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 7: ISA-88 FINITE STATE MACHINE (SLITTING & CONTINUOUS REWIND AUTOMATION PHASES)
========================================================================================================================
*)
CASE iMachineState OF

    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_IDLE: Machine stationary, drives inhibited, permissives checked *)
        rCmdUnwindTorque_Nm         := 0.0;
        rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin  := 0.0;
        rCmdRewindTorque_Nm         := 0.0;
        rCmdDancerPressure_bar      := 0.0;
        rCmdDancerVoiceCoil_N       := 0.0;
        rCmdEdgeGuideCorrection_mm  := 0.0;
        bLaserEmissionPermissive    := FALSE;
        rCmdLaserPower_W            := 0.0;
        bCycleComplete              := FALSE;
        bSpliceSequenceReady        := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Ready *)

        (* Start Cycle Transition Permissive *)
        IF bMasterEnable AND bSafetyRelayChainOk AND (wAlarmCodeWord1 = 0) AND bStartAutoCycle THEN
            tPhaseTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iMachineState := 10; (* Transition to Threading / Jogging *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_WEB_THREAD_JOG: Low-speed creep (15 m/min) for initial foil web threading *)
        rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin  := 15.0;
        rCmdDancerPressure_bar      := 1.2;  (* Light dancer bias *)
        rCmdUnwindTorque_Nm         := -rTensionTensionTorque_Nm * 0.25;
        rCmdRewindTorque_Nm         := (rWebTensionSetpoint_N * 0.25 * rFilteredRewindRadius_m) / c_rGearRatioRewind;
        bLaserEmissionPermissive    := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0003; (* Bit 0: Ready, Bit 1: Jogging *)

        (* Dwell for tension detection *)
        tPhaseTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
        IF tPhaseTimer.Q AND (rVotedWebTension_N > 2.0) THEN
            tPhaseTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iMachineState := 20; (* Advance to Tension Precharge *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_TENSION_PRECHARGE: Equilibrium tension lock & dancer center alignment *)
        rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin  := 0.0;  (* Locked capstan *)
        rCmdDancerPressure_bar      := rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar;
        rCmdUnwindTorque_Nm         := -rTensionTensionTorque_Nm + aControl_u[1];
        rCmdRewindTorque_Nm         := (rWebTensionSetpoint_N * rFilteredRewindRadius_m) / c_rGearRatioRewind;
        bLaserEmissionPermissive    := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0007; (* Bit 0: Ready, Bit 1: Jog, Bit 2: Tension Locked *)

        (* Check Tension Settlement within +/- 5% *)
        IF (ABS(rVotedWebTension_N - rWebTensionSetpoint_N) <= (rWebTensionSetpoint_N * 0.05)) AND
           (ABS(rDancerPos_Filt_mm) <= 3.5) THEN
            tPhaseTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1500MS);
            IF tPhaseTimer.Q THEN
                tPhaseTimer(IN := FALSE);
                bWebTensionOk := TRUE;
                iMachineState := 30; (* Advance to Acceleration Ramp *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tPhaseTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bWebTensionOk := FALSE;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_ACCEL_S_CURVE: Jerk-limited S-curve acceleration up to 1200 m/min *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#000F; (* Accelerating *)
        bLaserEmissionPermissive    := TRUE;

        (* S-Curve Speed Command Generator with Slew Limiting *)
        IF rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin < rLineSpeedSetpoint_mpmin THEN
            rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin := rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin + ((2.5 * 60.0) * c_rSamplingPeriod_s);
        ELSE
            rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin := rLineSpeedSetpoint_mpmin;
        END_IF;

        (* Dynamic Torque Synthesis with Inertia Compensation *)
        rCmdUnwindTorque_Nm := -rTensionTensionTorque_Nm - rInertiaFeedforwardTorque_Nm + aControl_u[1];
        rCmdRewindTorque_Nm := ((rWebTensionSetpoint_N * rFilteredRewindRadius_m) / c_rGearRatioRewind)
                               + ((rEstimatedRewindInertia_kgm2 * (rWebAcceleration_mps2 / rFilteredRewindRadius_m)) / c_rGearRatioRewind);
        rCmdDancerPressure_bar := rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar + aControl_u[3];

        (* Lateral Edge Guide Tracking *)
        rCmdEdgeGuideCorrection_mm := -0.65 * rWebEdgeGuideOffset_mm;

        (* Reached Line Speed Target *)
        IF (ABS(rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin - rLineSpeedSetpoint_mpmin) <= 5.0) THEN
            iMachineState := 40; (* Steady-state High-Speed Run *)
        END_IF;

        IF bControlledStopReq THEN
            iMachineState := 70;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_HIGH_SPEED_SLIT_RUN: Steady-state continuous laser slitting at 1200 m/min *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#001F; (* Full High-Speed Slitting Active *)
        bLaserEmissionPermissive    := TRUE;

        (* If degraded mode active, throttle speed to 500 m/min *)
        IF bDegradedModeActive THEN
            IF rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin > 500.0 THEN
                rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin := rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin - ((1.5 * 60.0) * c_rSamplingPeriod_s);
            ELSE
                rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin := 500.0;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin := rLineSpeedSetpoint_mpmin + aControl_u[2];
        END_IF;

        (* Torque & Decoupled Servo Commands *)
        rCmdUnwindTorque_Nm    := -rTensionTensionTorque_Nm + aControl_u[1];
        rCmdRewindTorque_Nm    := (rWebTensionSetpoint_N * rFilteredRewindRadius_m) / c_rGearRatioRewind;
        rCmdDancerPressure_bar := rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar + aControl_u[3];
        rCmdEdgeGuideCorrection_mm := -0.75 * rWebEdgeGuideOffset_mm;

        (* Monitor Flying Splice Request *)
        IF bFlyingSpliceTrigger THEN
            tPhaseTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iMachineState := 50; (* Enter Flying Splice Routine *)
        END_IF;

        IF bControlledStopReq THEN
            iMachineState := 70;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_TURRET_FLYING_SPLICE: High-speed roll swap, accumulator expansion & knife splice *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#003F; (* Splice Active *)
        bSpliceSequenceReady        := TRUE;

        (* Dynamic Accumulator Expansion: Expand dancer buffer volume *)
        rCmdDancerPressure_bar      := rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar + 0.85;

        (* Slightly decelerate line to 800 m/min during knife touch *)
        IF rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin > 800.0 THEN
            rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin := rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin - ((3.0 * 60.0) * c_rSamplingPeriod_s);
        END_IF;

        rCmdUnwindTorque_Nm := -rTensionTensionTorque_Nm + aControl_u[1];
        rCmdRewindTorque_Nm := (rWebTensionSetpoint_N * rFilteredRewindRadius_m) / c_rGearRatioRewind;

        (* Splice Sequence Execution Watchdog *)
        tSpliceWatchdogTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4200MS);
        IF tSpliceWatchdogTimer.Q THEN
            tSpliceWatchdogTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bSpliceSequenceReady := FALSE;
            iMachineState := 60; (* Splice Complete, Enter Post-Splice Recovery *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_POST_SPLICE_RECOVERY: Re-center dancer carriage and return to master setpoint *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#007F;
        rCmdDancerPressure_bar      := rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar;

        (* Ramp back to full line speed *)
        IF rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin < rLineSpeedSetpoint_mpmin THEN
            rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin := rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin + ((2.0 * 60.0) * c_rSamplingPeriod_s);
        ELSE
            rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin := rLineSpeedSetpoint_mpmin;
            iMachineState := 40; (* Return to steady-state slitting *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_CONTROLLED_DECEL_RAMP: Smooth regenerative deceleration to crawl speed *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#00FF; (* Decelerating *)

        (* Slew down at -3.0 m/s^2 *)
        IF rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin > 0.0 THEN
            rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin := rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin - ((3.0 * 60.0) * c_rSamplingPeriod_s);
        ELSE
            rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Deceleration Inertia Compensation *)
        rCmdUnwindTorque_Nm    := -rTensionTensionTorque_Nm - rInertiaFeedforwardTorque_Nm;
        rCmdRewindTorque_Nm    := (rWebTensionSetpoint_N * rFilteredRewindRadius_m) / c_rGearRatioRewind;
        rCmdDancerPressure_bar := rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar;

        (* Laser shutoff when below minimum cutting speed *)
        IF rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin < 25.0 THEN
            bLaserEmissionPermissive := FALSE;
            rCmdLaserPower_W         := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Transition to Hold when stopped *)
        IF (rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin <= 0.5) AND (rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin <= 0.0) THEN
            iMachineState := 80;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_PRODUCTION_HOLD: Zero speed, tension hold, finished coil demount *)
        rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin  := 0.0;
        bLaserEmissionPermissive    := FALSE;
        rCmdLaserPower_W            := 0.0;
        rCmdUnwindTorque_Nm         := -rTensionTensionTorque_Nm;
        rCmdRewindTorque_Nm         := (rWebTensionSetpoint_N * rFilteredRewindRadius_m) / c_rGearRatioRewind;
        rCmdDancerPressure_bar      := rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar;
        bCycleComplete              := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#01FF; (* Complete *)

        IF NOT bStartAutoCycle THEN
            iMachineState := 0; (* Return to standby *)
        END_IF;

    999: (* STATE_FAILSAFE_EMERGENCY_STOP: Total SIL-3 emergency torque off & mechanical brake hold *)
        rCmdUnwindTorque_Nm         := 0.0;
        rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin  := 0.0;
        rCmdRewindTorque_Nm         := 0.0;
        rCmdDancerPressure_bar      := 0.0;
        rCmdDancerVoiceCoil_N       := 0.0;
        rCmdEdgeGuideCorrection_mm  := 0.0;
        bLaserEmissionPermissive    := FALSE;
        rCmdLaserPower_W            := 0.0;
        rCmdLaserPulseFreq_kHz      := 0.0;
        rCmdLaserDutyCycle_pct      := 0.0;
        rCmdLaserGasFlow_bar        := 0.0;
        rCmdLaserFocusOffset_um     := 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#F999; (* Emergency trip active *)

        (* Fault Reset Logic: Requires physical reset button, healthy safety relay, and cleared trips *)
        IF bMasterResetPushbutton AND bSafetyRelayChainOk THEN
            wAlarmCodeWord1     := 0;
            wAlarmCodeWord2     := 0;
            bSystemAlarmSummary := FALSE;
            bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;
            iMachineState       := 0; (* Return to standby *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* Update Public Diagnostic State Variable *)
iActiveMachineState := iMachineState;
